thread.title: U10 Rawlins FC wins championship in Rock Challenge
thread.title_full: U10 Rawlins FC wins championship in Rock Challenge

author: Anden Garfield agarfield@rocketminer.com
title: U10 Rawlins FC wins championship in Rock Challenge
text:
ROCK SPRINGS -- The 2025 Rock Challenge hosted by the Rock Springs Avengers saw teams from three different towns claim championships in their respective brackets, including the U10 Rawlins FC.
U8 BOYS
The Rock Springs Avengers beat the 2018 Riverton Rampage 3-2 while Rawlins FC put up a 5-1 win over the 2019 Riverton Rampage in the first round. The 2018 Rampage beat their fellow Riverton team in a 3-0 shutout and the Avengers closed out the first day of competition with a 6-2 win over Rawlins FC.
To determine who would play in the championship, the Avengers beat the 2019 Rampage 3-0 and the 2018 Rampage beat Rawlins FC 3-2. The Avengers squared off against the 2018 Rampage in a 2-2 tie, where a 4-3 penalty kick finish gave Rock Springs the win.
U8 GIRLS
Day one saw the Lander Strikers beat Rawlins FC 4-1, the Riverton Rampage I beat the Rampage II 8-0, the Rock Springs Avengers beat Rawlins FC 4-1, the Strikers beat the Rampage II 5-0, and the Rampage I beat the Avengers 17-2.
The Rampage I continued their dominance with a 7-0 win over the Strikers and a 14-0 win over Rawlins FC. Meanwhile, the Rampage II battled to a 3-3 tie with Rawlins FC and 4-2 against the Avengers. The Avengers then edged out the Strikers 4-3 in the final game.
U10 BOYS
The Rock Springs Avengers became champions in their bracket after a tough tournament. They opened competition with a 5-1 loss to Mexico Utah Academy then picked themselves back up with a 4-3 win over the Riverton Rampage. They beat the Lander Strikers 5-2 to advance to the championship game where they met the Mexico Utah Academy again. The teams wrestled to a 5-5 tie before the Avengers went 5-4 in the penalty kicks to secure the win.
Rawlins FC took the championship in the other bracket after they beat Mexico Utah Academy 4-2, the Rock Springs Avengers 10-0 and the Green River Spurs 5-1. They rematched the Spurs in the championship game, which again ended 5-1 in favor of Rawlins FC.
U10 COED
The Rock Springs Avengers took an all-girls team into a co-ed bracket and came out undefeated. On the first day, they topped the Lander Strikers 5-2 and the Riverton Rampage 4-0. The championship game featured a rematch against Riverton, which Rock Springs won 3-0.
U12 BOYS
The Green River Spurs put together an undefeated performance to win the championship in their bracket. For them, the tournament consisted of a 17-0 win over the Rock Springs Avengers, a 14-3 win over the Riverton Rampage, a 9-1 semi-final win over the Lander Strikers and finally an 8-1 championship win over Mexico Utah Academy.
U15 BOYS
There were just three teams featured in this bracket, where the Rock Springs Avengers were the only team without a loss. On day one, they beat the Evanston Express 6-1 and beat the Lander Strikers 2-0. Lander beat Evanston 3-0 on that day. The Avengers rematched Lander in the championship, which resulted in a 5-2 victory for the Avengers.
U15 GIRLS
On the girls side of this age bracket, the Rock Springs Avengers still came out on top. Their first game against the Lander Strikers was won 6-1 before beating the WYO Elite 4-1. After Lander beat WYO Elite 2-1 in the semifinals, Rock Springs beat them 4-1 in the championship game to claim their title.
U19 BOYS
The Green River Spurs crushed all their opponents en route to the championship game. They started with a 4-1 win over Star Valley and finished the first day of the tournament with a 14-0 win over Rock Springs. They faced the Lander Strikers in the final match and topped them 7-0.
U19 GIRLS
Rock Springs and Star Valley were the only two teams competing. They played each other twice, with the Rock Springs Avengers winning the first one 4-2 and the second one 8-1.
The Rock Springs Avengers competitive soccer program will host their next tournament in February. It will be the Avenger Futbol Tournament for kids ages U8-U15, with registration closing on January 30.
